test_title: PYST 1: SSC CGL Tier - II (English) (Held on: 8 Aug 2022)
subject: english
question: According to the UN report, the fertility rate in 1950 stood at how many average births per woman?
solution:
The correct answer is option 4) i.e. '5 births per woman.' [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• The **first** sentence of the fifth paragraph says that "In 2021, the average fertility of the world's population stood at 2.3 births per woman over a lifetime, having fallen from about **5 births in 1950**."
 
• Therefore from the above sentence, we can certainly say that according to the UN report, the fertility rate in 1950 stood at 5 births per woman.
 
• Hence, the only possible answer is option 4.
